items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: And another fellow by the name of Samuel Dominic, we used to call him Bebe. He's in California, he has a stroke now, he don't play anymore. Joseph Pierre, he don't play anymore. He's in Biloxi, Mississippi. And we used to go around town.

ctx.x: Is it bigger than the Persia Victor horn? Is it bigger than this? I mean smaller? Just about a little smaller. A little smaller than this is a standard Victor horn with the brass on the end. Yeah, it's a little smaller. It must have been from a little cellular machine like on the Edison or Columbia, they had little tiny ones too. You put that on the answer.

I made a horn out of it. And I blowed it and by moving up and down I could make chords. Yeah. And there was a fellow by the name of Walter Nelson, he played a guitar. And another fellow by the name of Joseph Pierre. And another fellow by the name of Samuel Dominic, we used to call him Bebe. He's in California, he has a stroke now, he don't play anymore. Joseph Pierre, he don't play anymore. He's in Biloxi, Mississippi. And we used to go around town. And we used to name that the Funnel Foam. The Funnel Foam? The…
Was he on radio then already? Was he on radio? I used to hear him on radio when I was younger.
